prompt: Fix backslash round-trip corruption in python-dotenv. In src/dotenv/main.py, set_key() must preserve the exact value when a quoted value is written and read back through get_key()/dotenv_values(), including repeated backslashes, trailing backslashes, adjacent quotes, and multiline text. The quoted-value parsing in src/dotenv/parser.py must also keep subsequent assignments separate when a single- or double-quoted value ends in an escaped backslash. Preserve existing public APIs, quote modes, export handling, and unrelated file contents. You may modify only src/dotenv/main.py and src/dotenv/parser.py among preexisting files. Preserve all other preexisting files, including tests; you may add new test files. Run the relevant available tests and explain the fix briefly.

platform_exclusions.reason: This historical test invokes GNU printenv --version; macOS BSD printenv has no --version. The complete unchanged base suite reports 222 passed and this 1 unrelated failure.
